about: Henry M. Coxe, III is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2026. He works at Bedell, Dittmar, DeVault, Pillans & Coxe, P.A., located in Jacksonville, Florida, and provides legal services for issues involving Criminal Defense: White Collar and Criminal Defense to the surrounding community.
Henry Coxe, III completed legal studies at Washington and Lee University School of Law and graduated with the class of 1972. Henry Coxe, III passed the bar in 1972.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
